question: If I don't use up all my holiday this year, how much of it can I move into next year?
expected_texts: Up to 5 unused days can be carried over into the following calendar year.

question: When I'm ill, at what point do I have to hand in a doctor's note?
expected_texts: A medical certificate is required from day 3 of a continuous absence

question: How much paid time off does a new dad get if he is not the main carer of the baby?
expected_texts: Secondary caregivers receive 8 weeks of fully paid parental leave.

question: After paying for something out of my own pocket for work, how long do I have to ask for the money back?
expected_texts: Claims must be submitted within 45 days of the date of the expense.

question: Who gives the last sign-off when I ask to be paid back 3,000 euros?
expected_texts: Above 2,500 EUR: the CFO office gives the final approval after the department head.

question: On which day of the month does the money I spent for work land back in my bank account?
expected_texts: Claims approved by the 10th of the month are reimbursed with that month's payroll on the 25th.

question: How many days each week am I allowed to stay home instead of coming in?
expected_texts: Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week.

question: I'd like to spend part of the winter doing my job from my parents' place overseas. How long can I do that for in a year?
expected_texts: You may work from another country for up to 30 working days per calendar year.

question: During which part of a normal day is everybody expected to be reachable for meetings?
expected_texts: Core hours are 10:00 to 16:00 in the time zone of your office.

question: I think somebody broke into my work account. How fast do I need to tell someone?
expected_texts: Report any suspected security incident within 1 hour of noticing it.

question: If I walk away from my computer, how long before it should lock by itself?
expected_texts: The screen must lock automatically after 5 minutes of inactivity.

question: How long is the trial period at the start of a job for someone hired in Texas?
expected_texts: For employees in Austin the probation period is 90 days.

question: How frequently does a newcomer sit down with the colleague assigned to guide them?
expected_texts: You and your buddy meet for 30 minutes every week.

question: I have a twelve-hour flight to see a customer. Can I sit in the front cabin, and does anyone need to agree?
expected_texts: Flights longer than 10 hours: business class, with approval from a VP.

question: What is the most I can pay for a room for one night when I visit the Swedish capital for work?
expected_texts: Stockholm: 1,900 SEK per night.

question: How often does the company swap my work computer for a new one?
expected_texts: Laptops are replaced every 36 months.

question: When a merchant cannot take any money at all because our service is broken, how quickly do we promise to have it fixed?
expected_texts: P1: first response within 30 minutes and resolution within 4 hours.

question: On the middle tier, what does each extra request cost once a customer has used up the monthly quota?
expected_texts: Growth overage is 0.004 EUR per additional API call.

question: What does rejection code EXP-204 mean?
expected_texts: EXP-204: duplicate claim, the same receipt has already been submitted.

question: My claim was returned with EXP-310. What is wrong with it?
expected_texts: EXP-310: the amount is above the category limit and no pre-approval was attached.

question: What is form HR-17 used for?
expected_texts: All annual leave is requested in PeopleHub using form HR-17 (Leave Request).

question: What kind of incident is classified as SEV-2?
expected_texts: SEV-2: a compromise contained to one employee account or one internal system.

question: How is an NW-LAP asset tag structured?
expected_texts: Laptop asset tags follow the format NW-LAP-##### where the five digits are a serial number

question: What is the first response target for a P3 ticket?
expected_texts: P3: first response within 8 business hours and resolution within 5 business days.

question: What is form IT-12 and by when must it be completed?
expected_texts: complete form IT-12 (Lost Device Report) within 2 working days

question: What is HR-40 for and how early must it be sent?
expected_texts: Request it with form HR-40 (Work From Abroad Request) at least 21 days before you travel.

question: ¿Cuál es el horario de trabajo durante la jornada intensiva de verano?
expected_texts: Durante la jornada intensiva el horario es de 08:00 a 15:00, sin pausa para comer.

question: ¿Qué días puente regala la empresa en Barcelona este año?
expected_texts: En Barcelona hay 2 días puente en 2026: el viernes 25 de septiembre y el lunes 7 de diciembre.

question: Vivo en Sabadell pero mi contrato es de la oficina de Barcelona. ¿Qué fiestas locales me corresponden?
expected_texts: Quien vive en otra ciudad y trabaja para la oficina de Barcelona disfruta los festivos locales de Barcelona.

question: ¿Cuántos días festivos tiene la oficina de Estocolmo en 2026?
expected_texts: La oficina de Estocolmo tiene 11 festivos en 2026.

question: ¿Cuánto cuesta al mes el plan más caro de la plataforma?
expected_texts: Scale (plan code PLAN-SC) costs 899 EUR per month and includes 500,000 API calls per month.

question: ¿Cuál es el importe máximo por persona en una comida con clientes?
expected_texts: Client meals: up to 60 EUR per person, including the Northwind hosts.
